comment: Past bugs for dev/review-evals/run.js. Each case: the merge commit of the PR that brought the bug in, and the file and lines in that commit's copy that a later fix changed. attribution: notes (a note or commit names the cause) or blame (git blame of the fix's old lines). Gathered 2026-11-21 from dev/release-state.md, LESSONS.md and git; lines spot-checked for pathkey-quadratic-trim, enotdir-read-as-unread and only-default-concurrency.

cases.title: The redirect decision test tries characters that fold onto ASCII, but its paths hold no s, K or I, so a folding compare passes
The note-cut test puts the launcher path at fixed offsets, so from a checkout whose launcher path is 158 characters or more it fails
release-check.sh traps INT, TERM and HUP and exits 130, 143 or 129 instead of raising the signal again, so a calling shell loop goes on
--only with a name pattern runs every test file at Node's default concurrency instead of two at a time
Only the 20 newest kept run folders stay and every --only run keeps one, so passing --only runs delete a failed run's output
The commit-list tests' 30 s control passes budgetMs 30000, but each git call is still capped at 4 s, so one slow call fails the test
pathKey trims trailing separators with a regex that is quadratic on a long run of backslashes on Linux and macOS
list() treats only ENOENT as gone when it adds the unread flag, so ENOTDIR on Linux and macOS reports the Codex cache as unreadable
The hook's time is checked before each nested repo's check but not inside one, so one check reading many config files runs past 5 s
